artifact.scope: Frame the bench-clamp holding and damage-prevention problem for teaching and subsequent test planning. This is a draft problem brief, not an approved requirements baseline or evidence of product performance.

conditions.text: The supplied task specifies a bench clamp and the desired outcome of holding a workpiece without damage.
Customer load, workpiece material, geometry and damage criterion are unknown; specifications and acceptance thresholds cannot yet be fixed.
The supplied lunar-sampling excerpt concerns a different environment. Its transferability is not established; its parameters and reported achievements provide no proof of bench-clamp performance.

payload.actor: Intended bench-clamp operator; customer identity, capabilities and work context are unknown.
payload.boundary: Teaching concept and test planning only; customer load, material, geometry and damage criterion unknown. Stop specification finalization until these conditions are clarified. No concept selection, physical testing or engineering validation is established.

requirements.text: The bench clamp should retain the intended workpiece during the intended operation under use conditions to be established.
requirements.acceptance: Proposed verification plan only: first establish workpiece geometry, applied loads, load directions, holding duration and allowable movement with the responsible stakeholder; then plan a retention test against those agreed conditions. No threshold or result is available.

requirements.text: Clamping and release should leave the workpiece within an agreed damage criterion.
requirements.acceptance: Proposed verification plan only: identify material, surface condition and unacceptable changes; agree inspection methods and acceptance limits before planning a before-and-after assessment. Damage criteria and results remain unknown.

conditions.text: Whether adequate retention and acceptable workpiece condition can be achieved together is unresolved for the customer's unknown use conditions.
Requirement owners, confirmation authority, priority rules and change-approval responsibilities have not been supplied. Both requirements remain draft proposals.
Proposed change process: retain requirement IDs and revision history, record the reason for each change, and revisit affected concepts and verification plans before establishing a confirmed baseline.
